name: Larkspur decisions
description: Larkspur's architecture decision records (docs/adr): each decision, its status and date, what superseded it, and the modules it affects.

decision.label: ADR {number}: {title}
decision.description: One numbered record in docs/adr. Never edited after it is accepted; a changed mind is a new record that supersedes the old one.

number.description: The record's number, from its file name and heading.

title.description: The record's heading, without its number.

file.description: Where the record lives in the repository.

wholeRepository.label: Affects the whole repository
wholeRepository.description: The record's Affects line says the whole repository rather than naming modules.

module.label: {path}
module.description: A workspace package that pnpm-workspace.yaml takes in: a directory under services/, packages/ or tools/ with its own package.json.

path.description: The directory, from the repository root.

add-decision.title: Record a decision
add-decision.description: Add a decision record from docs/adr.

affect-module.title: Say it affects a module
affect-module.description: Name a module this decision affects.
affect-module.fromTheOtherEnd: Name a decision that affects it

unaffect-module.title: Say it no longer affects a module
unaffect-module.description: Take a module off this decision's Affects line.

mark-superseded.title: Name what superseded it
mark-superseded.description: Name the decision that superseded this one, and mark it superseded.

unmark-superseded.title: It is not superseded
unmark-superseded.description: Take back what superseded this decision, and mark it accepted again.
unmark-superseded.fromTheOtherEnd: Take back a decision it supersedes

reject-decision.title: Reject it
reject-decision.description: Mark the decision rejected: it was considered and not taken.

superseded-names-successor.title: A superseded decision names what superseded it
superseded-names-successor.says: ADR {number} is superseded but does not say by what

successor-is-marked-superseded.title: A decision something supersedes says so
successor-is-marked-superseded.says: ADR {number} has a successor but its status is {status}

successor-is-accepted.title: What supersedes a decision is accepted
successor-is-accepted.says: ADR {number} is superseded by a decision that is not accepted

successor-is-newer.title: A decision is superseded only by a later one
successor-is-newer.says: ADR {number} is superseded by a decision dated before it

proposal-not-left-open.title: A proposal is decided within 90 days
proposal-not-left-open.says: ADR {number} has been proposed since {date} and is still open

accepted-affects-something.title: An accepted decision affects something
accepted-affects-something.says: ADR {number} is accepted but names no module it affects
